description_en: Retrieves the managed transform configuration for a site
description_zh: 查询站点托管转换配置
name: GetManagedTransform

parameters.description_en: The ID of the site. You can obtain this ID by calling the [ListSites](~~2850189~~) operation.
parameters.description_zh: 站点ID，可以通过调用[ListSites](~~2850189~~)获取。
parameters.help_en: The ID of the site. You can obtain this ID by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2850189.html operation
parameters.name: site_id

parameters.description_en: The site version. If version management is enabled for the site, use this parameter to specify the version whose configuration you want to retrieve. The default is 0.
parameters.description_zh: 站点的版本号。开启了版本管理的站点，可以通过该参数指定配置生效的站点版本，默认为版本0。
parameters.help_en: The site version. If version management is enabled for the site, use this parameter to specify the version whose configuration you want to retrieve. The default is 0
parameters.help_zh: 站点的版本号。开启了版本管理的站点，可以通过该参数指定配置生效的站点版本，默认为版本0
parameters.name: site_version
